title: Desk Guidance Note: Vehicle, Garaging and Lienholder Endorsements on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
On a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, vehicles are added, replaced or removed, and garaging or lienholder changes are made, by endorsement. Adding, changing, suspending or removing an optional vehicle coverage is an endorsement as well.

## Conditions on every vehicle endorsement

- **Policy status.** The policy status must be bound or in force when the change is processed. A policy that is cancel pending, cancelled, nonrenewed or expired accepts no vehicle changes. The status is read from the policy record of the policy being changed.
- **Household vehicle.** A vehicle can be scheduled only if it belongs to the named insured's household vehicle records.

| Policy status when the change is processed | Vehicle, garaging, lienholder or optional coverage endorsement |
|---|---|
| Bound or in force | May be processed |
| Cancel pending, cancelled, nonrenewed or expired | Not accepted |

## Adding and replacing vehicles

- **Vehicle cap.** An additional vehicle may be added only while the policy schedules fewer vehicles than its package's vehicle maximum. The count of vehicles scheduled on the policy is taken from the policy's transaction history. A replacement does not change the count.
- **Newly acquired additional vehicle.** It is automatically covered from its acquisition date with the broadest coverage carried on any scheduled vehicle. That automatic coverage holds only if the vehicle is reported within the package's newly acquired vehicle report window, and in that case the add is effective on the acquisition date. A vehicle reported later is added effective the date of the request.
- **Time rule.** The additional vehicle keeps its acquisition-date effective date only when it is reported no later than the window's number of calendar days after the customer acquired the vehicle. The count runs in calendar days from the acquisition date on the vehicle record, the acquisition date itself being day 0, and a report on the last day of the window is in time. The acquisition date is taken from the vehicle record of the vehicle being added, not from the customer's recollection.
- **Replacement vehicle.** A replacement vehicle takes over the liability coverages of the vehicle it replaces from the acquisition date for the rest of the term. Physical damage on the replacement follows the newly acquired vehicle provisions of Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage.

### Boundary cases on the report window (hypothetical, 14-day window)

| Report made on | Day count from acquisition | Add effective |
|---|---|---|
| Acquisition date | 0 | Acquisition date |
| 14th calendar day after acquisition | 14 | Acquisition date (last day of the window is in time) |
| 15th calendar day after acquisition | 15 | Date of the request |

On a package with a 30-day window, day 30 is the last in-time day and day 31 is late.

## Removing vehicles

- Removing the last vehicle on a policy is not an endorsement. It is processed as an insured-requested cancellation.
- Removing a vehicle removes any Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, Cardinal Roadside Assistance and Cardinal DriveSense enrollment attached to it, under those coverages' own rules.

## Lienholders and garaging

- **Lienholders.** A financed or leased vehicle must carry its lienholder or lessor as loss payee, recorded exactly as printed on the finance or lease contract. A lienholder change is recorded the same way. A lienholder change carries no premium effect and no endorsement fee.
- **Garaging change.** A garaging change re-rates the vehicle at the new ZIP code from the date the vehicle began to be garaged there. A move to a state where the policy is not written (outside the policy's state) cannot be endorsed and requires a new policy in the new state.

## Optional vehicle coverages

Adding, changing, suspending or removing an optional vehicle coverage (physical damage and its deductible or options, rental reimbursement, roadside assistance) is decided under that coverage's own rules and re-rated on this policy. Its premium difference is prorated under the midterm premium change standard. It carries no endorsement fee.
